title: एकोननवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 189 · The story of the five Indras

summary.en: Vyasa tells Drupada how five former Indras, imprisoned by Shiva in a cave, were sent to be born on earth as the Pandavas, with Shri, born as Draupadi, destined as their common wife. Granting Drupada divine sight, he shows him the Pandavas in their divine forms.
summary.kn: ಶಿವನು ಗುಹೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಐವರು ಹಿಂದಿನ ಇಂದ್ರರು ಪಾಂಡವರಾಗಿ ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರೆಂದೂ, ದ್ರೌಪದಿಯಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅವರ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪತ್ನಿಯಾಗಲು ನಿಯತಳಾದಳೆಂದೂ ವ್ಯಾಸರು ದ್ರುಪದನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ದಿವ್ಯದೃಷ್ಟಿ ನೀಡಿ ಪಾಂಡವರನ್ನು ದಿವ್ಯರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: व्यास द्रुपद को बताते हैं कि शिव द्वारा गुफा में बन्द किए गए पाँच पूर्व इन्द्र पाण्डवों के रूप में पृथ्वी पर जन्मे, और द्रौपदी के रूप में जन्मी श्री उनकी सामान्य पत्नी होने के लिए नियत हैं। वे द्रुपद को दिव्य दृष्टि देकर पाण्डवों को उनके दिव्य रूपों में दिखाते हैं।
summary.te: శివుడు గుహలో బంధించిన ఐదుగురు పూర్వ ఇంద్రులు పాండవులుగా భూమిపై జన్మించారని, ద్రౌపదిగా పుట్టిన శ్రీ వారి ఉమ్మడి భార్య కావడానికి నియతమైందని వ్యాసుడు ద్రుపదునికి చెబుతాడు. దివ్యదృష్టి ఇచ్చి పాండవులను దివ్యరూపాలలో చూపిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: ஶிவனால் குகையில் அடைக்கப்பட்ட முன்னாள் இந்திரர்கள் ஐவர் பாண்டவர்களாகப் பூமியில் பிறந்தனர் என்றும், திரௌபதியாகப் பிறந்த ஸ்ரீ அவர்களின் பொது மனைவியாக விதிக்கப்பட்டவள் என்றும் வியாஸர் த்ருபதனிடம் சொல்கிறார். ஞானக்கண் அருளிப் பாண்டவர்களை அவர்களின் தெய்வ வடிவில் காட்டுகிறார்.
summary.ml: പണ്ട് ശിവൻ ഒരു ഗുഹയിൽ തടവിലാക്കിയ അഞ്ചു മുൻ ഇന്ദ്രന്മാർ പാണ്ഡവരായി ഭൂമിയിൽ ജനിക്കാൻ അയയ്ക്കപ്പെട്ടതും, ദ്രൗപദിയായി ജനിച്ച ശ്രീ അവരുടെ പൊതുഭാര്യയാകാൻ നിശ്ചയിക്കപ്പെട്ടതും വ്യാസൻ ദ്രുപദനോട് പറയുന്നു. ദ്രുപദന് ദിവ്യദൃഷ്ടി നൽകിയ അദ്ദേഹം പാണ്ഡവരെ അവരുടെ ദിവ്യരൂപത്തിൽ കാണിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.189; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
पुरा वै नैमिषारण्ये देवाः सत्रमुपासते ।
तत्र वैवस्वतो राजञ्शामित्रमकरोत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Long ago, in the Naimisha forest, the gods were attending a sacrificial session, and there, king, Vaivasvata Yama served as the slaughterer of the victim.

verses.text:
ततो यमो दीक्षितस्तत्र राज-
न्नामारयत्किंचिदपि प्रजाभ्यः ।
ततः प्रजास्ता बहुला बभूवुः
कालातिपातान्मरणात्प्रहीणाः ॥

meaning.en: Then Yama, consecrated for the rite, took the life of no creature. So the creatures multiplied greatly, and deaths ceased as time went by.

verses.text:
ततस्तु शक्रो वरुणः कुबेरः
साध्या रुद्रा वसवश्चाश्विनौ च ।
प्रणेतारं भुवनस्य प्रजापतिं
समाजग्मुस्तत्र देवास्तथान्ये ॥

meaning.en: Then Indra, Varuna, Kubera, the Sadhyas, Rudras, Vasus and the two Ashvins, and the other gods too, went to Prajapati, the leader of the world.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रुवँल्लोकगुरुं समेता
भयं नस्तीव्रं मानुषाणां विवृद्ध्या ।
तस्माद्भयादुद्विजन्तः सुखेप्सवः
प्रयाम सर्वे शरणं भवन्तम् ॥

meaning.en: Gathered, they said to the teacher of the world: We have a sharp fear because of the growth of mankind. Dreading this fear and wanting happiness, we all come to you for refuge.

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
किं वो भयं मानुषेभ्यो यूयं सर्वे यदामराः ।
मा वो मर्त्यसकाशाद्वै भयं भवतु कर्हिचित् ॥

meaning.en: Why should you fear men when you are all immortal? Never let there be fear for you from mortals.

verses.text: देवा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The gods said:

verses.text:
मर्त्या ह्यमर्त्याः संवृत्ता न विशेषोऽस्ति कश्चन ।
अविशेषादुद्विजन्तो विशेषार्थमिहागताः ॥

meaning.en: Mortals have become immortal, and there is no difference. We are alarmed by that lack of difference and have come here to have a difference made.

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
वैवस्वतो व्यापृतः सत्रहेतो-
स्तेन त्विमे न म्रियन्ते मनुष्याः ।
तस्मिन्नेकाग्रे कृतसर्वकार्ये
तत एषां भवितैवान्तकालः ॥

meaning.en: Vaivasvata is occupied with the sacrificial session, so these men do not die. When he is free, his work done, then the end-time of these men will come.

verses.text:
वैवस्वतस्यापि तनुर्विभूता
वीर्येण युष्माकमुत प्रयुक्ता ।
सैषामन्तो भविता ह्यन्तकाले
तनुर्हि वीर्यं भविता नरेषु ॥

meaning.en: Vaivasvata's own body, too, is pervasive and has been supplied by your strength. At the end time, that body will be their end; for it will become the strength in men.

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
ततस्तु ते पूर्वजदेववाक्यं
श्रुत्वा देवा यत्र देवा यजन्ते ।
समासीनास्ते समेता महाबला
भागीरथ्यां ददृशुः पुण्डरीकम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods, hearing the words of the eldest god, went where the gods sacrifice; seated together, those mighty ones saw a lotus on the Bhagirathi.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा च तद्विस्मितास्ते बभूवु-
स्तेषामिन्द्रस्तत्र शूरो जगाम ।
सोऽपश्यद्योषामथ पावकप्रभां
यत्र गङ्गा सततं संप्रसूता ॥

meaning.en: Seeing it they were amazed. The hero Indra went there. At the source where the Ganga always flows, he saw a woman radiant as fire.

verses.text:
सा तत्र योषा रुदती जलार्थिनी
गङ्गां देवीं व्यवगाह्यावतिष्ठत् ।
तस्याश्रुबिन्दुः पतितो जले वै
तत्पद्ममासीदथ तत्र काञ्चनम् ॥

meaning.en: There the woman, weeping and seeking water, stood having bathed in the goddess Ganga. A tear of hers fell into the water, and it became a golden lotus.

verses.text:
तदद्भुतं प्रेक्ष्य वज्री तदानी-
मपृच्छत्तां योषितमन्तिकाद्वै ।
का त्वं कथं रोदिषि कस्य हेतो-
र्वाक्यं तथ्यं कामयेह ब्रवीहि ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that marvel, the wielder of the thunderbolt went close and asked that woman: Who are you, why do you weep and for what reason? Tell me truly what you wish.

verses.text: स्त्र्युवाच

meaning.en: The woman said:

verses.text:
त्वं वेत्स्यसे मामिह यास्मि शक्र
यदर्थं चाहं रोदिमि मन्दभाग्या ।
आगच्छ राजन्पुरतोऽहं गमिष्ये
द्रष्टासि तद्रोदिमि यत्कृतेऽहम् ॥

meaning.en: You will learn who I am here, Indra, and why I weep, unlucky as I am. Come, king; I will go ahead, and you will see why I weep.

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
तां गच्छन्तीमन्वगच्छत्तदानीं
सोऽपश्यदारात्तरुणं दर्शनीयम् ।
सिंहासनस्थं युवतीसहायं
क्रीडन्तमक्षैर्गिरिराजमूर्ध्नि ॥

meaning.en: As she went, he followed her, and nearby he saw a handsome young man seated on a throne with a young woman, playing dice on the peak of the king of mountains.

verses.text:
तमब्रवीद्देवराजो ममेदं
त्वं विद्धि विश्वं भुवनं वशे स्थितम् ।
ईशोऽहमस्मीति समन्युरब्रवी-
द्दृष्ट्वा तमक्षैः सुभृशं प्रमत्तम् ॥

meaning.en: The king of the gods said to him: Know that this universe is under my control. 'I am the lord,' he said angrily, seeing the other absorbed in his dice.

verses.text:
क्रुद्धं तु शक्रं प्रसमीक्ष्य देवो
जहास शक्रं च शनैरुदैक्षत ।
संस्तम्भितोऽभूदथ देवराज-
स्तेनेक्षितः स्थाणुरिवावतस्थे ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Indra angry, the god laughed and slowly looked at Indra. At his glance the king of the gods was paralysed and stood like a post.

verses.text:
यदा तु पर्याप्तमिहास्य क्रीडया
तदा देवीं रुदतीं तामुवाच ।
आनीयतामेष यतोऽहमारा-
न्मैनं दर्पः पुनरप्याविशेत ॥

meaning.en: When he had played enough, he said to the weeping goddess: Bring this one here to me, so that pride does not enter him again.

verses.text:
ततः शक्रः स्पृष्टमात्रस्तया तु
स्रस्तैरङ्गैः पतितोऽभूद्धरण्याम् ।
तमब्रवीद्भगवानुग्रतेजा
मैवं पुनः शक्र कृथाः कथंचित् ॥

meaning.en: At her mere touch Indra's limbs went slack and he fell to the ground. The venerable one of fierce power said to him: Never do so again, Indra.

verses.text:
विवर्तयैनं च महाद्रिराजं
बलं च वीर्यं च तवाप्रमेयम् ।
विवृत्य चैवाविश मध्यमस्य
यत्रासते त्वद्विधाः सूर्यभासः ॥

meaning.en: Roll away this great king of mountains, whose strength and power are immeasurable, and enter its hollow, where others like you, shining like the sun, are staying.

verses.text:
स तद्विवृत्य शिखरं महागिरे-
स्तुल्यद्युतींश्चतुरोऽन्यान्ददर्श ।
स तानभिप्रेक्ष्य बभूव दुःखितः
कच्चिन्नाहं भविता वै यथेमे ॥

meaning.en: He rolled aside that peak of the great mountain and saw four others of equal radiance. Seeing them, he became sad, thinking, 'Will I become like them?'

verses.text:
ततो देवो गिरिशो वज्रपाणिं
विवृत्य नेत्रे कुपितोऽभ्युवाच ।
दरीमेतां प्रविश त्वं शतक्रतो
यन्मां बाल्यादवमंस्थाः पुरस्तात् ॥

meaning.en: Then the god Shiva, the lord of the mountain, opening his eyes in anger, said to the holder of the thunderbolt: Enter this cave, Shatakratu, since you scorned me earlier in your folly.

verses.text:
उक्तस्त्वेवं विभुना देवराजः
प्रवेपमानो भृशमेवाभिषङ्गात् ।
स्रस्तैरङ्गैरनिलेनेव नुन्न-
मश्वत्थपत्रं गिरिराजमूर्ध्नि ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by the lord, the king of the gods trembled greatly from the shock, his limbs loosened, like a peepal leaf shaken by the wind on a mountain peak.

verses.text:
स प्राञ्जलिर्विनतेनाननेन
प्रवेपमानः सहसैवमुक्तः ।
उवाच चेदं बहुरूपमुग्रं
द्रष्टा शेषस्य भगवंस्त्वं भवाद्य ॥

meaning.en: With joined palms and bowed face, trembling, spoken to so suddenly, he said: Lord, today you have become the beholder of Shesha, in many fierce forms.

verses.text:
तमब्रवीदुग्रधन्वा प्रहस्य
नैवंशीलाः शेषमिहाप्नुवन्ति ।
एतेऽप्येवं भवितारः पुरस्ता-
त्तस्मादेतां दरिमाविश्य शेध्वम् ॥

meaning.en: The wielder of the fierce bow smiled and said to him: Those of such conduct do not obtain Shesha. These others will also be like this in time, so enter this cave and lie there.

verses.text:
शेषोऽप्येवं भविता वो न संशयो
योनिं सर्वे मानुषीमाविशध्वम् ।
तत्र यूयं कर्म कृत्वाविषह्यं
बहूनन्यान्निधनं प्रापयित्वा ॥

meaning.en: Shesha too will be so, without doubt; all of you enter a human womb. There, having done deeds hard to bear and sent many others to death,

verses.text:
आगन्तारः पुनरेवेन्द्रलोकं
स्वकर्मणा पूर्वजितं महार्हम् ।
सर्वं मया भाषितमेतदेवं
कर्तव्यमन्यद्विविधार्थवच्च ॥

meaning.en: you will come back to Indra's world, won earlier by your own deeds and of great worth. All this has been told by me; the other things to be done are of various kinds and aims.

verses.text: पूर्वेन्द्रा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The former Indras said:

verses.text:
गमिष्यामो मानुषं देवलोका-
द्दुराधरो विहितो यत्र मोक्षः ।
देवास्त्वस्मानादधीरञ्जनन्यां
धर्मो वायुर्मघवानश्विनौ च ॥

meaning.en: We will go from the world of the gods to the human world, where release is hard to obtain. But let the gods Dharma, Vayu, Indra and the Ashvins beget us in the mother.

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वज्रपाणिर्वचस्तु
देवश्रेष्ठं पुनरेवेदमाह ।
वीर्येणाहं पुरुषं कार्यहेतो-
र्दद्यामेषां पञ्चमं मत्प्रसूतम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, the wielder of the thunderbolt again spoke to the best of gods: By my own strength I will give them a fifth man, born of me, for the purpose.

verses.text:
तेषां कामं भगवानुग्रधन्वा
प्रादादिष्टं सन्निसर्गाद्यथोक्तम् ।
तां चाप्येषां योषितं लोककान्तां
श्रियं भार्यां व्यदधान्मानुषेषु ॥

meaning.en: The venerable one of the fierce bow granted their wish as desired, as appointed in the creation, and he ordained that woman, Shri, beloved of the world, to be their wife among men.

verses.text:
तैरेव सार्धं तु ततः स देवो
जगाम नारायणमप्रमेयम् ।
स चापि तद्व्यदधात्सर्वमेव
ततः सर्वे संबभूवुर्धरण्याम् ॥

meaning.en: Then with those very ones the god went to Narayana, the immeasurable, and he too arranged all this; then all came into being on earth.

verses.text:
स चापि केशौ हरिरुद्बबर्ह
शुक्लमेकमपरं चापि कृष्णम् ।
तौ चापि केशौ विशतां यदूनां
कुले स्त्रियौ रोहिणीं देवकीं च ।
तयोरेको बलदेवो बभूव
कृष्णो द्वितीयः केशवः संबभूव ॥

meaning.en: And Hari pulled out two hairs, one white and one black. Those two hairs entered two women of the Yadu family, Rohini and Devaki. Of them one became Baladeva, and the second, the dark one, became Keshava.

verses.text:
ये ते पूर्वं शक्ररूपा निरुद्धा-
स्तस्यां दर्यां पर्वतस्योत्तरस्य ।
इहैव ते पाण्डवा वीर्यवन्तः
शक्रस्यांशः पाण्डवः सव्यसाची ॥

meaning.en: Those former Indras who were shut up in that cave of the northern mountain are these valiant Pandavas here; and Arjuna Savyasachin is a portion of Indra.

verses.text:
एवमेते पाण्डवाः संबभूवु-
र्ये ते राजन्पूर्वमिन्द्रा बभूवुः ।
लक्ष्मीश्चैषां पूर्वमेवोपदिष्टा
भार्या यैषा द्रौपदी दिव्यरूपा ॥

meaning.en: Thus these Pandavas came to be, who were formerly Indras, king; and Shri, who was assigned to them as wife earlier, is this Draupadi of divine form.

verses.text:
कथं हि स्त्री कर्मणोऽन्ते महीतला-
त्समुत्तिष्ठेदन्यतो दैवयोगात् ।
यस्या रूपं सोमसूर्यप्रकाशं
गन्धश्चाग्र्यः क्रोशमात्रात्प्रवाति ॥

meaning.en: How else could a woman rise from the earth at the end of a rite by divine arrangement, whose form shines like the moon and sun, and whose excellent fragrance is borne for a krosha?

verses.text:
इदं चान्यत्प्रीतिपूर्वं नरेन्द्र
ददामि ते वरमत्यद्भुतं च ।
दिव्यं चक्षुः पश्य कुन्तीसुतांस्त्वं
पुण्यैर्दिव्यैः पूर्वदेहैरुपेतान् ॥

meaning.en: And I give you another gift, king, out of affection, a most wonderful one: take divine sight and see the sons of Kunti endowed with their meritorious former divine bodies.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततो व्यासः परमोदारकर्मा
शुचिर्विप्रस्तपसा तस्य राज्ञः ।
चक्षुर्दिव्यं प्रददौ तान्स सर्वा-
न्राजापश्यत्पूर्वदेहैर्यथावत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Vyasa, the pure Brahmin of most noble deeds, gave the king divine sight by his austerity, and the king saw them all in their former forms.

verses.text:
ततो दिव्यान्हेमकिरीटमालिनः
शक्रप्रख्यान्पावकादित्यवर्णान् ।
बद्धापीडांश्चारुरूपांश्च यूनो
व्यूढोरस्कांस्तालमात्रान्ददर्श ॥

meaning.en: Then he saw them, divine, with golden crowns and garlands, like Indra, with the hues of fire and sun, with hair bound, handsome and young, with broad chests, a palm tall.

verses.text:
दिव्यैर्वस्त्रैररजोभिः सुवर्णै-
र्माल्यैश्चाग्र्यैः शोभमानानतीव ।
साक्षात्त्र्यक्षान्वसवो वाथ दिव्या-
नादित्यान्वा सर्वगुणोपपन्नान् ।
तान्पूर्वेन्द्रानेवमीक्ष्याभिरूपा-
न्प्रीतो राजा द्रुपदो विस्मितश्च ॥

meaning.en: They shone greatly with clean divine garments, gold and excellent garlands, like three-eyed Shiva himself or divine Vasus or Adityas, endowed with every virtue. Seeing those former Indras so handsome, King Drupada was pleased and amazed.

verses.text:
दिव्यां मायां तामवाप्याप्रमेयां
तां चैवाग्र्यां श्रियमिव रूपिणीं च ।
योग्यां तेषां रूपतेजोयशोभिः
पत्नीमृद्धां दृष्टवान्पार्थिवेन्द्रः ॥

meaning.en: Having obtained that divine, immeasurable power of illusion, the king saw their prosperous wife, the supreme Shri herself in bodily form, fit for them in beauty, radiance and glory.

verses.text:
स तद्दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यरूपं
जग्राह पादौ सत्यवत्याः सुतस्य ।
नैतच्चित्रं परमर्षे त्वयीति
प्रसन्नचेताः स उवाच चैनम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that form of great wonder, he clasped the feet of Satyavati's son. 'This is no marvel in you, supreme sage,' he said with a pleased heart.

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
आसीत्तपोवने काचिदृषेः कन्या महात्मनः ।
नाध्यगच्छत्पतिं सा तु कन्या रूपवती सती ॥

meaning.en: There was once, in an ascetic grove, the daughter of a great-souled sage. That maiden, beautiful and virtuous, found no husband.

verses.text:
तोषयामास तपसा सा किलोग्रेण शंकरम् ।
तामुवाचेश्वरः प्रीतो वृणु काममिति स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: She pleased Shankara with fierce austerity, and the lord, pleased, himself told her, 'Choose a boon.'

verses.text:
सैवमुक्ताब्रवीत्कन्या देवं वरदमीश्वरम् ।
पतिं सर्वगुणोपेतमिच्छामीति पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, the maiden said to the god, the lord who grants boons, again and again: I want a husband endowed with every virtue.

verses.text:
ददौ तस्यै स देवेशस्तं वरं प्रीतिमांस्तदा ।
पञ्च ते पतयः श्रेष्ठा भविष्यन्तीति शंकरः ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord of the gods, Shankara, pleased, gave her that boon: You shall have five excellent husbands.

verses.text:
सा प्रसादयती देवमिदं भूयोऽभ्यभाषत ।
एकं पतिं गुणोपेतं त्वत्तोऽर्हामीति वै तदा ।
तां देवदेवः प्रीतात्मा पुनः प्राह शुभं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Seeking to appease the god, she again said: I deserve one husband endowed with virtues from you. The god of gods, pleased, again spoke kind words to her:

verses.text:
पञ्चकृत्वस्त्वया उक्तः पतिं देहीत्यहं पुनः ।
तत्तथा भविता भद्रे तव तद्भद्रमस्तु ते ।
देहमन्यं गतायास्ते यथोक्तं तद्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: You said 'Give me a husband' five times. So it shall be, good lady; good fortune to you. When you have gone to another body, what I said will come to pass.

verses.text:
द्रुपदैषा हि सा जज्ञे सुता ते देवरूपिणी ।
पञ्चानां विहिता पत्नी कृष्णा पार्षत्यनिन्दिता ॥

meaning.en: Drupada, she has been born as this daughter of yours, godlike in form, the blameless Krishna, Prishata's granddaughter, ordained wife of five.

verses.text:
स्वर्गश्रीः पाण्डवार्थाय समुत्पन्ना महामखे ।
सेह तप्त्वा तपो घोरं दुहितृत्वं तवागता ॥

meaning.en: The Shri of heaven was born for the Pandavas at a great sacrifice; having performed fierce austerity here, she has come to be your daughter.

verses.text:
सैषा देवी रुचिरा देवजुष्टा
पञ्चानामेका स्वकृतेन कर्मणा ।
सृष्टा स्वयं देवपत्नी स्वयम्भुवा
श्रुत्वा राजन्द्रुपदेष्टं कुरुष्व ॥

meaning.en: This lovely goddess, served by the gods, one woman for five husbands by her own deed, was made by the Self-existent himself as the wife of gods. King, having heard this, do what pleases you, Drupada.
